title: Water after a wall is removed

samples.question: The dark blocks make a landscape of columns standing on the ground, and the pale blue blocks are the rain water trapped in that landscape as it is drawn. Water is only held where taller columns stand on both sides of it; water that can reach either open end of the landscape runs off. Exactly one column is red. Take that whole red column away, down to the ground, leave every other column exactly as it is, and let the water settle again. How many blocks deep is the water standing directly above the column the black arrow points at? Answer with the number of blocks alone: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
